outcome: heart failure during a procedure or surgery
cohort: 3,098,578 pregnant women in California between 2007 and 2012, including 2,910 women with a prior diagnosis of endometriosis
finding: Women with pregnancies complicated by endometriosis were 2.41 times more likely to develop severe maternal morbidity than women who did not have endometriosis.
mod_finding: The risk of severe maternal morbidity was higher for vaginal delivery (aOR, 4.59; 95% CI, 2.73-7.71) than for cesarean delivery (aOR, 1.64; 95% CI, 1.37-1.97) (P-interaction<.0001).
